Package com.compdfkit.core.signature

Class CPDFSignatureValidationOptions

java.lang.Object
com.compdfkit.core.signature.CPDFSignatureValidationOptions
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
public class CPDFSignatureValidationOptions extends Object implements Cloneable
Checks and trust settings for CPDFSignatureValidator.

Defaults enable integrity, coverage, document permissions, certificate-chain and timestamp checks. Revocation and LTV checks are disabled by default; enable setCheckRevocation(boolean) for meaningful LT/LTA results.

Certificate and timestamp trust use the native OpenSSL trust anchors configured by setTrustedCertPath(String), not the JVM trust store. Missing anchors can leave those checks INDETERMINATE. A successful subset of checks is not a substitute for full signature validation.

Setters return this instance. Callers must not mutate it concurrently with submitting a validation operation.

    • setCheckRevocation

      public CPDFSignatureValidationOptions setCheckRevocation(boolean checkRevocation)
      Revocation and LTV checking. Default false.

      This flag gates the whole DSS/VRI inspection, not just network lookups: with it off the validator emits no ltv.* item at all and always reports pades.baseline_lt.incomplete, so CPDFSignatureValidationReport.isLtvEnabled() returns false even for a correctly LTV-enabled document. Turn it on to get a meaningful LTV verdict.

      Validation itself is offline — OCSP responses and CRLs are read from the document's DSS. Run it off the main thread anyway: the validator hashes the whole file and verifies every embedded revocation object.

      Parameters:
      checkRevocation - true to inspect and validate embedded revocation/LTV evidence; default is false
      Returns:
      this for chained configuration
